intro: Liechtenstein has about 40,000 people, most of whom speak German.

chapters.title: People
text: Vaduz is the capital and Schaan the largest town. Many people working in Liechtenstein commute from Switzerland and Austria. Most people are Catholic.

chapters.title: Daily life
text: On National Day, 15 August, the prince invites everyone to the castle gardens for a drink.

keyTerms.meaning: Travel regularly between home and work.
